name: Coconut shrimp
summary: Small shrimp fried with coconut on the Cồn Phụng lunch list. Vietnam Tourism calls the grove lunch coconut-braised shrimp. The two wordings both stand. A recipe was not printed. A price is check on arrival.
origin: The Cồn Phụng lunch, and the grove lunch Vietnam Tourism describes.
howToEat: Eat it at the same lunch as the coconut rice. The rural article says fried with coconut. Vietnam Tourism says braised with coconut. Neither page prints a method beyond that.
